API Integration Example

import httpx

async def generate_music(prompt, duration=30):
    response = await httpx.AsyncClient().post(
        "https://your-api.com/ai/music",
        json={"prompt": prompt, "duration": duration, "model": "music-2.6"}
    )
    return response.json()

The FastAPI layer handles API key security - MiniMax key never touches the client.
